ai.en: Hello! What would you like to drink?
Okay. Would you like hot tea?
Okay. Would you like something to eat?
Okay. Ten yuan.
You're welcome! Goodbye!

you.en: I would like some tea.
Yes, I'd like hot tea.
I don't want anything to eat, thanks.
Okay, thank you!

scenarios.title: Introduce yourself
goals: Say hello and give your name

ai.en: Hello! What is your name?

ai.zh: 认识你，我很高兴。你在哪儿工作？
ai.en: I am very glad to meet you. Where do you work?

ai.zh: 我是医生。你喜欢你的工作吗？
ai.en: I am a doctor. Do you like your work?
Your Chinese is very good!
Goodbye!

you.en: Hello, my name is Xiaoming.
I work at a company. And you?

you.zh: 我很喜欢。我也喜欢学习汉语。
you.en: I like it a lot. I also like studying Chinese.
Thank you! Goodbye!

scenarios.title: Ask the price
goals: Say what you want to buy

ai.en: Hello! What would you like to buy?
This one looks very nice. It is 100 yuan.
This one is 80 yuan.
Okay. Thank you!
Goodbye!

you.en: I want to buy an item of clothing.
That is too expensive. Is there a cheaper one?
Good, I'll take this one.
Thank you, goodbye!

scenarios.title: Ask where something is
goals: Ask if you can take a taxi

ai.en: Hello! Where would you like to go?
The hospital is over by the school.
Yes, you can. Take a taxi.
You're welcome! Goodbye!
Goodbye!

you.en: Excuse me, where is the hospital?
Can I take a taxi there?
Okay, thank you!
Goodbye!

scenarios.title: Talk about your family
goals: Say how many people are in your family
Say you have an older brother

ai.en: Hello! How many people are in your family?
Do you have an older brother?
What does your older brother do?
Your family are all well, right?
Great! Goodbye!

you.en: There are four people in my family.
Yes, I have an older brother.

you.zh: 他在医院工作，他是医生。
you.en: He works at a hospital. He is a doctor.
Yes, we are all fine.

ai.en: Hello! Do you have time tomorrow?
Let's go and watch a movie!
How about three o'clock in the afternoon?
Let's meet at the cinema.
See you tomorrow!

you.en: Yes, I have time tomorrow afternoon.
Good, what time shall we go?
That works. Where shall we meet?
Okay, see you tomorrow!

ai.en: Hello! Who are you?

ai.zh: 她不在家，她在公司工作。
ai.en: She is not at home. She is at work.
She finishes work at six.
You're welcome! Goodbye!
Goodbye!

you.zh: 喂，我是小明。你妈妈在家吗？
you.en: Hello, I am Xiaoming. Is your mom at home?
What time does she finish work?

you.zh: 好，我六点再打电话。谢谢！
you.en: Okay, I'll call again at six. Thank you!
Goodbye!

scenarios.title: Talk about the weather
goals: Say what the weather is like

ai.en: Hello! How is the weather today?

ai.zh: 对，太冷了！你想喝热茶吗？
ai.en: Yes, it is so cold! Would you like some hot tea?
Do you like cold weather?
Me too! The weather will be very nice tomorrow.
See you tomorrow!

you.en: It is very cold today, and it is raining too.
Yes, I'd like some hot tea, thank you.

you.zh: 我不太喜欢冷的天气，我喜欢热的天气。
you.en: I don't like cold weather much. I like hot weather.
Great! See you tomorrow!

phrases.en: Please say it one more time.
